Let the final coat cure for a day.
Wear thick gloves when you sand it.

Colds can make the symptoms worse.
The first reaction is usually mild.

The trail was muddy but fun.
We rode it again the next morning.

The leaves turn pink in autumn.
Tip: plant it near a sunny wall.

The study had a small sample.
Still, the results look promising.

Keep the dough in the fridge overnight.
Roll it out before it warms.

The bridge closed for repairs.
Traffic now uses the river road.

Our cat sleeps most of the day.
At night she patrols the kitchen.
quiet: Let the final coat cure for a day, and wear thick gloves when you sand it.
Colds can make the symptoms worse, though the first reaction is usually mild.
The trail was muddy but fun, so we rode it again the next morning.
The leaves turn pink in autumn, so plant it near a sunny wall.
The study had a small sample, but the results look promising.
Keep the dough in the fridge overnight and roll it out before it warms.
The bridge closed for repairs and traffic now uses the river road.
Our cat sleeps most of the day and patrols the kitchen at night.
